title: An Early Fare to the Museum
story: Luis and his mother compared two train fares to the city. The early train was cheaper, but it left at dawn. The later train cost more and arrived at the same station. They chose the early train and kept the difference for museum tickets. They packed their bags the night before and set an alarm. At dawn they walked to the station and bought tea. The carriage was quiet, and Luis read a guide to the museum. When they arrived, they used the saved money for two student tickets. Inside, they saw tools, maps, and a model of the old port. Luis took notes because his class was studying the city. At lunch they still had a little money left for soup. His mother said the early start had paid for the visit. Luis agreed and circled the cheap fare in the leaflet.
